component.name: folio
component.summary: Documents with live data inside, beautiful by default

description.p: folio is the document Word should have been. Write reports where the numbers live in the document and calculate as you type, the page looks finished from the first word, and the file is plain Markdown that anyone can read.

ul.li: Tables are live datasets: typed columns, units, and formulas that recalculate as you edit
Charts are drawn from the document's own tables, so they never go out of date
Ten themes, each with a dark mode, restyle the whole document at once
Equations, code, diagrams, drawings, 3D models and sheet music in the page
Export to PDF that looks like a report, not a web page
Plain Markdown files: open them in any editor, keep them in Git, read them on GitHub

description.p: Everything works offline, with no account. folio is open source under the MIT licence.

screenshot.caption: A quarterly report with live tables and charts
The same report in four themes, light and dark
Insert tables, charts, equations, diagrams and 3D models

description.p: A new look, and Linux packages that update themselves.

ul.li: Install from folio's own Flatpak, dnf or apt repository and get updates through your system
The Flatpak's icon now shows on high-resolution displays
Live tables, charts, equations, diagrams, 3D models and sheet music in plain Markdown documents
Ten themes, each with a dark mode
Open Markdown files straight from the file manager
